\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 329-332 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R337-first-pass-words-from-chapters-329-332}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a principal and tuition.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an article, a poem, a play, football, cricket
  \item a lid, a jar, a water pot, a sack, gold
  \item a coconut scraper, a spatula, a clay water jug, a wire, wool
  \item a coconut shell, firewood, charcoal, ash, a sapling
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An article? (\textbf{\ml{ലേഖനം}}, \emph{lēkhanaṁ}.) A poem? (\textbf{\ml{കവിത}}, \emph{kavita}.) A play? (\textbf{\ml{നാടകം}}, \emph{nāṭakaṁ}.) Football? (\textbf{\ml{ഫുട്ബോൾ}}, \emph{phuṭbōḷ}.) Cricket? (\textbf{\ml{ക്രിക്കറ്റ്}}, \emph{krikkaṟṟŭ}.) A lid? (\textbf{\ml{മൂടി}}, \emph{mūṭi}.) A jar? (\textbf{\ml{ഭരണി}}, \emph{bharaṇi}.) A water pot? (\textbf{\ml{കുടം}}, \emph{kuṭaṁ}.) A sack? (\textbf{\ml{ചാക്ക്}}, \emph{cākkŭ}.) Gold? (\textbf{\ml{സ്വർണ്ണം}}, \emph{svarṇṇaṁ}.) A coconut scraper? (\textbf{\ml{ചിരവ}}, \emph{cirava}.) A spatula? (\textbf{\ml{ചട്ടുകം}}, \emph{caṭṭukaṁ}.) A clay water jug? (\textbf{\ml{കൂജ}}, \emph{kūja}.) A wire? (\textbf{\ml{കമ്പി}}, \emph{kampi}.) Wool? (\textbf{\ml{കമ്പിളി}}, \emph{kampiḷi}.) A coconut shell? (\textbf{\ml{ചിരട്ട}}, \emph{ciraṭṭa}.) Firewood? (\textbf{\ml{വിറക്}}, \emph{viṟakŭ}.) Charcoal? (\textbf{\ml{കരി}}, \emph{kari}.) Ash? (\textbf{\ml{ചാരം}}, \emph{cāraṁ}.) A sapling? (\textbf{\ml{തൈ}}, \emph{tai}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 333-337 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R337-second-pass-words-from-chapters-333-337}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a cashew nut and sugarcane.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a cashew nut, sugarcane, a sickle, a bindi, a helmet
  \item an employee, a boss, a manager, a company, a meeting
  \item a degree, a subject, mathematics, homework, a letter
  \item a sale, a machine, farming, science, history
  \item chalk, a uniform, an essay, a principal, tuition
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A cashew nut? (\textbf{\ml{കശുവണ്ടി}}, \emph{kaśuvaṇṭi}.) Sugarcane? (\textbf{\ml{കരിമ്പ്}}, \emph{karimpŭ}.) A sickle? (\textbf{\ml{അരിവാൾ}}, \emph{arivāḷ}.) A bindi? (\textbf{\ml{പൊട്ട്}}, \emph{poṭṭŭ}.) A helmet? (\textbf{\ml{ഹെൽമെറ്റ്}}, \emph{helmeṟṟŭ}.) An employee? (\textbf{\ml{ജീവനക്കാരൻ}}, \emph{jīvanakkāran}.) A boss? (\textbf{\ml{മുതലാളി}}, \emph{mutalāḷi}.) A manager? (\textbf{\ml{മാനേജർ}}, \emph{mānējar}.) A company? (\textbf{\ml{കമ്പനി}}, \emph{kampani}.) A meeting? (\textbf{\ml{യോഗം}}, \emph{yōgaṁ}.) A degree? (\textbf{\ml{ബിരുദം}}, \emph{birudaṁ}.) A subject? (\textbf{\ml{വിഷയം}}, \emph{viṣayaṁ}.) Mathematics? (\textbf{\ml{കണക്ക്}}, \emph{kaṇakkŭ}.) Homework? (\textbf{\ml{ഗൃഹപാഠം}}, \emph{gṛhapāṭhaṁ}.) A letter? (\textbf{\ml{അക്ഷരം}}, \emph{akṣaraṁ}.) A sale? (\textbf{\ml{വിൽപ്പന}}, \emph{vilppana}.) A machine? (\textbf{\ml{യന്ത്രം}}, \emph{yantraṁ}.) Farming? (\textbf{\ml{കൃഷി}}, \emph{kṛṣi}.) Science? (\textbf{\ml{ശാസ്ത്രം}}, \emph{śāstraṁ}.) History? (\textbf{\ml{ചരിത്രം}}, \emph{caritraṁ}.) Chalk? (\textbf{\ml{ചോക്ക്}}, \emph{cōkkŭ}.) A uniform? (\textbf{\ml{യൂണിഫോം}}, \emph{yūṇiphōṁ}.) An essay? (\textbf{\ml{ഉപന്യാസം}}, \emph{upanyāsaṁ}.) A principal? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രിൻസിപ്പൽ}}, \emph{prinsippal}.) Tuition? (\textbf{\ml{ട്യൂഷൻ}}, \emph{ṭyūṣan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
